user_data.layout: meta.json + words.jsonl + lock + audit.jsonl + native/ + native-manifest.json + backups/
user_data.engine_access: read-only native directory at engine construction

methods: record_commit(text, pinyin, source='commit', event_id=None, learning_eligible=True, private=False, purpose='text')
native: lexicon.service.rebuild_native(store, base_lexicon, base_manifest=None, runtime_dir=None, system_data=None, probe=0)

evaluation.contamination: zero exact answer/readings overlap with base lexicon

engine_integration.current_limitation: engine 0.1.0 hardcodes pinyin_init(data_dir, NULL); no user_dir or import_dictionary API
engine_integration.bridge: lexicon.engine.open_engine injects the user directory for the construction call and restores Native; no engine files changed
engine_integration.reload_rule: rebuild native/ then create a new engine context; existing sessions do not see new entries
engine_integration.request_to_engine: add user_dir or import_dictionary with capability flags and stable error codes
engine_integration.write_ownership: lexicon writes user data; engine loads native/ read-only and must not call pinyin_train/save there

handoff_notes.platform: Pass the chosen user-data path to lexicon; call record_commit only for eligible, non-private, allowed-purpose commits with event_id; rebuild native at idle and recreate the engine context.
handoff_notes.interface: Expose a persistent learning switch and custom phrase management through these APIs; never write meta.json/words.jsonl directly; show learning-disabled reasons.
handoff_notes.delivery: Preserve the user data directory across install/upgrade/uninstall; ship data/base, build/base-v1, corpus/eval and licenses; run lexicon/tools/run_checks.py after packaging; native tables are version-bound to libpinyin 2.6.0.
handoff_notes.engine: Formalize user_dir/import_dictionary; keep the current lexicon JSONL/native contract; do not write into the lexicon user directory.
